newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER - FOSHAN TIES WITH TIANJIN IN CHINA CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - FOSHAN TIES WITH TIANJIN IN CHINA CUP.

text.p: Foshan Fosidi forced a 1-1 tie against Tianjin Samsung in its opening match of the Chinese Football Association Cup in Foshan in southern Guangdong province on Sunday, the Xinhua news agency said.
Foshan, a second-division side, surprised first-division club Tianjin Samsung with concerted fast attacks from the start and had several scoring chances in the first half.
Foshan opened the scoring in the last minute of the first half, when Shao Aiming headed the ball past goalkeeper Shi Lianzhi into the net on a pass from Zhang Lei.
Tianjin levelled to 1-1 in the 81st minute.
In other matches, Henan Jianye lost to Qingdao Hainiu 2-3, Tianjin Wanke drew with Guangzhou Apollo 1-1, and Vanguards Huandao squashed Shenzhen Ping'an 4-1.
Shenzhen Jinpeng beat Shanghai Yuyuan 2-1, Locomotive tied with August First 0-0, Shenyang Haishi beat Wuhan Yaqi 4-2 and Yanbian Aodong lost to Liaoning 0-1.
